name: Philiscus
bio: Philiscus is one of the named epigrammatists whose short poems are preserved in the Greek Anthology. Paton's Index of Authors dates the poet to the 4th century BC.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fourth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XI: 441.

poems.title: Book XI, 441
poems.author: Philiscus
poems.text: The Piraeus is a big nut and empty.
